text_block_list.text:
To support Haru Urara who works so hard in 
her races, I organized an all-you-can-pick 
carrot event at the field, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I'm, totally fine. But, you see... 
it just doesn't feel exciting.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
My body feels, like, super heavy... 
...Maybe I'll save the carrots for next 
time.

...The cause is likely fatigue from 
running in consecutive races. It seems 
necessary to reconsider the schedule for 
the future.
